title: Association schemes from vectorial generalized Maiorana-McFarland bent functions with non-weakly regular components
summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime, $q=p^k$, and $r=p^s$ with $s\mid k$. We study $\mathbb{F}_r$-valued generalized Maiorana-McFarland functions $H(x,y,z)=P^{(z)}(x)+\operatorname{Tr}_s^k(yz)$ on $V_n\times\mathbb{F}_q\times\mathbb{F}_q$. The ingredients $P^{(z)}$ are vectorial dual-bent functions with weakly regular components, constant on the cosets of $\mathbb{F}_r^*$ in $\mathbb{F}_q^*$, and, for $z\ne 0$, of inversion type with respect to $t\mapsto t^{-1}$.
